    AI Overview
    Kim Mulkey is the head coach of the LSU Tigers women's basketball team, having led them to the 2023 NCAA National Championship and multiple Elite Eight appearances since her hiring in 2021. Known for her high-fashion outfits and intense coaching style, she is a Hall of Fame coach who has won championships as a player, assistant, and head coach.

    ESPN College Football

    Key Details About Coach Kim Mulkey: 
    • Hired:
      April 25, 2021.
    • Achievements: 2023 NCAA Champion (LSU), 4x National Coach of the Year, Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame (2021).
    • Record: Known for being the fastest coach in Division I history to reach 600 wins.
    • Previous Role: Served as head coach at Baylor for 21 seasons, winning three national titles. 
    Mulkey signed a massive contract to lead the Tigers, immediately transforming them into a national powerhouse.

    What is Kim Mulkey's salary?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Following the 2023 national championship, LSU coach Kim Mulkey signed a 10-year, $36 million contract extension, making her one of the highest-paid coaches in women's college basketball. Her annual compensation for the 2024-2025 season is approximately $3.26 million, featuring yearly increases that will bring her salary up to $4.05 million by the end of the deal. 
    Key Details of Kim Mulkey's Contract: 
    • Total Value: $36 million over 10 years.
    • Annual Structure: Began at $3.15 million, increasing by $100,000 each year to reach $4.05 million
      .
    • Previous Salary: Roughly $2.5 million annually under her original 2021 contract.
    • Bonuses: Includes incentives such as $5,000 for a Sweet 16 appearance and $30,000 for playing in the national championship. 
    While she was initially the highest-paid in the sport, as of early 2025, she is frequently cited alongside top earners like South Carolina's Dawn Staley.
